title: Bunny Garden
synopsis: Qureate’s bunny-girl bar dating game — retained as the Asian English-language Nintendo Switch physical edition.

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Bunny Garden is Qureate’s adventure game set in a bunny-girl bar: the protagonist, Kosuke, spends his evenings and his money getting to know three hostesses, Kana, Rin, and Miuka, while working odd jobs to pay for it.

It released on the Nintendo Switch eShop on April 18, 2024. A physical edition with English text followed in Asia on July 25, 2024, distributed by Arc System Works Asia.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is the Asian physical edition of Bunny Garden on a Nintendo Switch game card, with English text.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Nintendo Switch eShop release April 18, 2024; a Steam version followed later in 2024. The Asian physical edition released July 25, 2024.
preservation.availability: Physically distributed in Asia only, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
